name: card
description: Card surfaces, spacing, title typography, and footer treatment match the web renderer.

props.name: size
props.description: Visible control size, matching the web renderer. Native touch areas extend beyond it.

props.name: accessibilityHint
props.description:
An accessibility hint helps users understand what will happen when they perform
an action on the accessibility element when that result is not obvious from the
accessibility label.


See https://reactnative.dev/docs/view#accessibilityHint

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description:
Overrides the text that's read by the screen reader when the user interacts
with the element. By default, the label is constructed by traversing all
the children and accumulating all the `Text` nodes separated by space.

See https://reactnative.dev/docs/view#accessibilitylabel

props.name: accessibilityState
props.description: Indicates to accessibility services that UI Component is in a specific State.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the part.

props.name: hitSlop
props.description:
This defines how far a touch event can start away from the view.
Typical interface guidelines recommend touch targets that are at least
30 - 40 points/density-independent pixels.

> The touch area never extends past the parent view bounds and the Z-index
> of sibling views always takes precedence if a touch hits two overlapping
> views.

See https://reactnative.dev/docs/view#hitslop

props.name: onBlur
props.type: ((event: Readonly<{ bubbles: boolean | undefined; cancelable: boolean | undefined; currentTarget: number | ReactNativeElement; defaultPrevented: boolean | un…
props.description:
Callback that is called when the view is blurred.

Note: This will only be called if the view is focusable.

props.name: onFocus
props.type: ((event: Readonly<{ bubbles: boolean | undefined; cancelable: boolean | undefined; currentTarget: number | ReactNativeElement; defaultPrevented: boolean | un…
props.description:

props.name: style
props.description: Native styles merged after the component defaults.

props.name: testID
props.description:
Used to locate this view in end-to-end tests.

> This disables the 'layout-only view removal' optimization for this view!

See https://reactnative.dev/docs/view#testid
